mapper.select: SELECT st_asgeojson ( st_closestpoint ( st_geomfromgeojson ( #{contourOne} ), st_geomfromgeojson ( #{contourTwo} ) ) ) AS contourOne, st_asgeojson ( st_closestpoint ( st_geomfromgeojson ( #{contourTwo} ), st_geomfromgeojson ( #{contourOne} ) ) ) AS contourTwo
SELECT ST_Distance ( st_geomfromgeojson ( #{contourOne} ), st_geomfromgeojson ( #{contourTwo} ) ) AS minDistance

WITH polygon1 AS ( SELECT ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(#{contourOne}) AS geom ), polygon2 AS ( SELECT ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(#{contourTwo}) AS geom ),
points_polygon1 AS ( SELECT (ST_DumpPoints(p1.geom)).geom AS point_geom FROM polygon1 p1 ),
points_polygon2 AS ( SELECT (ST_DumpPoints(p2.geom)).geom AS point_geom FROM polygon2 p2 ),
distances_1_to_2 AS ( SELECT ST_Distance(points_polygon1.point_geom, p2.geom) AS distance FROM points_polygon1, polygon2 p2 ),
distances_2_to_1 AS ( SELECT ST_Distance(points_polygon2.point_geom, p1.geom) AS distance FROM points_polygon2, polygon1 p1 )
SELECT (avg_1_to_2 + avg_2_to_1) / 2 AS meanDistance FROM ( SELECT AVG(distance) AS avg_1_to_2, (SELECT AVG(distance) FROM distances_2_to_1) AS avg_2_to_1 FROM distances_1_to_2 ) subquery;
